utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking something cozy this month—want me to check what’s on the shortlist?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, can you confirm the shortlist?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure — I’ll check the shortlist and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the book club plan to the others and see who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks, Vik. Let me know who’s in when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll ask around and let you know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the book club reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re reading a mystery novel this month — I’ll grab the title for you on my way back.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll wait for the title.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the book club? I’d be glad to hear what you’re reading.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re reading a mystery this month, and I’m making sure we’ve got enough copies and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds lovely. If you need an extra set of hands, I can help with the copies or bring something simple for snacks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check the school calendar and see what evenings are open for book club.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, thanks, Faye — I really appreciate you checking!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll take a look tonight and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like that to be simple and steady—what book are we reading, and when’s the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—simple and steady is best. I just need to check the book list, but I think we can set the next meeting for next Tuesday evening.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Next Tuesday evening works for me. Let me know the book as soon as you check the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club? I should mention that to everyone—want me to invite you to the next one?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please—just let me know the time and place so I can check my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and get the time and place to you as soon as I have it. I’ll make sure you’re on the invite list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve heard the book club meets over on Maple Street—what book are you all reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re reading "The Night Circus" this month—it’s been a lovely pick so far. If you’d like, I can save you a spot for the next meeting on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be wonderful, thank you—I’d love a spot for the next meeting on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good—what book are we discussing, and when’s the club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re discussing "The Night Circus," and the club meets this Thursday at 7 at my place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—"The Night Circus" this Thursday at 7 at your place. I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might sit this one out, Dane, but I hope the book club goes well.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, no worries — I’ll fill you in on how it goes next time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’d appreciate that — maybe I’ll be back next time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—how’s the book club going, Mina?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pretty good—have you picked the next book yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, but I’ve got a few ideas if you want to help pick one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t pinned down the book club spot yet—do you want me to check where we usually meet?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, please check our usual spot if you can—I’m trying to keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check our usual spot and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the book club needs anything, I’ve got a few tools and can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’s really kind of you. I’ll mention it to the book club and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know, and I’ll help out if I can.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to sort out the time and where we’re meeting first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm whether we’re doing Thursday at your place or somewhere else?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at my place works if we keep it simple, but I’d want to confirm the headcount first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club? I’d be happy to help connect everyone and see what we’re reading this month.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful, Jules—thank you. Let’s get everyone looped in and see what title we’re on this month.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I'll check in with everyone and bring back the title so we can all get on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the snacks and tea covered for book club—do we need any extra chairs?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can grab a couple of extra chairs on my way over if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, thanks—just a couple should do it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking the next read soon—do you want me to ask around for the title?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please—if you could ask around, that’d be great. I need to make sure it doesn’t clash with the kids’ school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, I’ll ask around and see when they’re leaning toward meeting too. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the title.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, book club—nice. What’s the next read?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re reading "The Midnight Library" next—hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh nice, I’ve heard of that one. I’ll try to make it!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’d be happy to help with the book club. What are we sorting out?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — could you help pick the next book and set a meeting time?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with both. Do you have a few book ideas already, and what days usually work best for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you should come to book club this week — I think you’d really like it. We’re meeting Wednesday evening, and I can send you the details!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds nice — I’d like that. Please send me the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send them over right away, and I’m glad you’re coming!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the book club meets at the library on Maple Street, usually in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right to me. I’ll plan on the library on Maple Street, in the community room.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that’s the one — the library on Maple Street, community room.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at your place for book club, or did that change?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m pretty sure it’s still at my place, but let me double-check the details and confirm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—can you let me know as soon as you confirm?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, book club? I’ve been meaning to ask—what are you all reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—uh, I think we’re reading that mystery one this week. I should probably check the exact title before I say it out loud.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries—I’m happy to wait. Just let me know the title when you’ve checked.
